00077 #define EVENT_CHAINBANKFUNCTION_DOCS                    You must implement this virtual function in your subclass.                      \
00078                                                         The parent Bank or Chain UGen calls this function multiple times to             \
00079                                                         create an array of UGen instances to use in a chain or bank structure.          \
00080                                                         @param input        If this is used in a Bank UGen this will be the             \
00081                                                                             input to the Bank and all events get the same input.        \
00082                                                                             If this is used in a Chain UGen the first link (when        \
00083                                                                             eventCount is 0) will get the input to the chain but        \
00084                                                                             subsequent links will get the output of the previous        \
00085                                                                             link as their input.                                        \
00086                                                         @param eventCount   The index of the event instance starting at 0 for           \
00087                                                                             the first event.                                            \
00088                                                         @return             The UGen graph for this event instance.

00113 template <class ChainLinkType, class OwnerType>
00114 class ChainUGenInternal : public ChainBaseUGenInternal
00115 {
00116 public:
00117     ChainUGenInternal(UGen const& input, const int size, const int numChannels, OwnerType* o) throw()
00118     :   ChainBaseUGenInternal(input, size, numChannels), chainLinkCreator(o)
00119     { 
00120         init(input, size);
00121     }
00122     
00123     ChainUGenInternal(UGen const& input, const int size, const int numChannels, ChainLinkType const& e) throw()
00124     :   ChainBaseUGenInternal(input, size, numChannels), chainLinkCreator(e)
00125     { 
00126         init(input, size);
00127     }
00128 
00129 private:
00130     void init(UGen const& input, const int size)
00131     {
00132         UGen nextInput = input;
00133         for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00134         {
00135             nextInput = chainLinkCreator.createEvent(nextInput, i);
00136             chain.put(i, nextInput);
00137         }
00138     }
00139     
00140 protected:
00141     ChainLinkType chainLinkCreator;
00142 };
